reasoning: 1. TARGET ENGAGEMENT: No biomarker data available to assess whether nivolumab engaged PD-1 or whether relatlimab/ipilimumab engaged their respective targets (LAG-3/CTLA-4). Cannot determine if drugs reached intended targets. 2. PATHWAY MODULATION: No pathway biomarkers or pharmacodynamic markers reported to assess downstream checkpoint blockade biology changes. 3. CLINICAL TRANSLATION: Primary endpoint was change in activated GZMB+ CD8+ T-cell density intratumorally, but no results were reported - endpoint was not met and no effect size or p-value provided. 4. POPULATION EFFECTS: No subgroup findings reported. 5. CONFOUNDERS: Major confounder identified - trial was terminated due to 'loss of funding' according to investigator commentary. Sample size was only 2 patients, making this severely underpowered. The 50% incidence of serious adrenal insufficiency in the nivolumab plus ipilimumab arm suggests potential safety issues, but with only 2 patients total, this represents 1 patient and is not statistically meaningful.
